data.title: 佐天泪子 · 夜风天台的微风掀裙
data.action: 双手压住险些被夜风掀起的睡裙下摆，头上的白梅花发饰轻颤，迎着风回过头来爽朗大笑，眼底闪烁着夏夜特有的清透与活泼。
data.location: 学园都市学生宿舍屋顶平台，栏杆外是远近交错的巨大风力发电风车与璀璨灯火
data.lighting: 城市天际线的蓝白霓虹与楼顶暖黄防空灯相映，风车阴影随夜风缓缓掠过
data.mood: 元气无能力者少女的爽朗治愈，随性、健康而充满青春悸动
data.description: 学园都市学生宿舍屋顶平台，栏杆外是远近交错的巨大风力发电风车与璀璨灯火。双手压住险些被夜风掀起的睡裙下摆，头上的白梅花发饰轻颤，迎着风回过头来爽朗大笑，眼底闪烁着夏夜特有的清透与活泼。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哇啊！晚上的风好大好舒服！哈哈，初春如果在的话又要说我不知检点了呢！”
data.promptProse: Out on the open dormitory rooftop terrace on a breezy summer night, Ruiko wears a lightweight pure white cotton spaghetti-strap slip dress with tiny plum-blossom embroidery along its ruffled hem. Pressing both hands down to keep the billowing fabric from lifting in the warm gusts, she turns back toward the viewer with a bright, carefree laugh. Neon Academy City lights and towering spinning wind turbines glitter across the dark skyline behind the rooftop railing.
data.animaCaption: Standing by the breezy dormitory rooftop railing in her white ruffled cotton slip dress, Ruiko holds down the wind-lifted hem with both hands and laughs brightly back toward the viewer. Neon city lights and distant wind turbines glow across the summer night sky.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a breezy pure white cotton spaghetti-strap slip dress embroidered with tiny plum blossoms and finished with a light ruffled hem.
